mechanics.original_reminder: As a sorcery, exile this from your hand face down for {2}. Cast it with different mana cost and color on a later turn.
mechanics.executable_reminder: As a sorcery, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its printed alternative mana cost. When cast this way, this spell and the permanent it becomes have the printed alternative mana cost, its corresponding colors, and the printed alternative power and toughness if present. It keeps its other characteristics. These are copiable characteristics.

rule_text.name: 702.298a
rule_text.rule: Forsake is a static ability that appears on forsake cards that have a secondary set of mana cost and/or power and toughness characteristics. Any time a player could cast a sorcery, they may pay {2} and exile a card with forsake from their hand face down. That player may look at that card as long as it remains in exile. After the current turn has ended, they may cast that card from exile "forsaken." If they do, the alternative set of its mana cost and/or power and toughness characteristics are used. See 751, “Prototype Cards.”

rule_text.name: 702.298b
rule_text.rule: Exiling a card using its forsake ability is a special action, which doesn’t use the stack. See rule 116, “Special Actions.”

rule_text.name: 702.298c
rule_text.rule: If a player owns multiple forsake cards in exile, they must ensure that those cards can be easily differentiated from each other and from any other face-down cards in exile which that player owns. This includes knowing the order in which those cards were put into exile.

rule_text.name: 702.298d
rule_text.rule: If a player leaves the game, all face-down forsake cards that player owns must be revealed to all players. At the end of each game, all face-down forsake cards must be revealed to all players.
